script.opening_line: Hello {{lead_name}}, this is Anil from Green Acres Homes, about your enquiry for our Kondapur flats. Can you talk now?

stages.name: Still looking
stages.instruction: Ask whether they are still looking for a flat.

scripts.en-IN: Are you still looking for a flat?

branches.when: They bought elsewhere or are not interested

stages.name: Budget and timeline
stages.instruction: Ask their budget, when they want to move in and their interest level.

scripts.en-IN: What budget do you have in mind?

stages.name: Site visit
stages.instruction: Offer a site visit this weekend and note the day they prefer; say the sales team will confirm it.

scripts.en-IN: We have site visits this Saturday and Sunday. Which day would suit you?

stages.name: Finalise the call
stages.instruction: Thank them and say the sales team will confirm the visit.

scripts.en-IN: Thank you. Our sales team will confirm your visit.

step_outcomes.outcome: The person says whether they are still looking.
Their budget and move-in time are known.
The person books a Saturday site visit.
The person knows the team will confirm.
